purpose: Prospectively validate the fixed ten-vector upstream program, two fixed readers, and six direction-only MLP15/17 mediator gains on a fourth disjoint Task14 corpus before any new causal clamp outcome is opened.

prior_art_search.result: Three earlier corpora validate midpoint/readout transfer and the ten-vector program; only the third corpus identifies and row-holdout-screens the six mediator gains. No fourth-corpus prospective mediator prediction exists.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_seal: All 12 direction x template x role native cells reach accuracy >=0.75; exactly 512 unique row-subset predictions are sealed before causal outcomes.
predictions.pred_b_fixed_reader_predicts_program_eff: Frozen reader q_hat predicts installed program q with cosine >=0.90, relative L2 <=0.45, and signs >=0.85.
predictions.pred_c_mlp15_transfer: Frozen six-gain MLP15 prediction reaches cosine >=0.75, relative L2 <=0.75, and signs >=0.65.
predictions.pred_d_mlp17_and_interaction_transfer: Each frozen MLP17 and interaction prediction reaches cosine >=0.90, relative L2 <=0.40, and signs >=0.90.
predictions.pred_e_joint_and_each_template_transfer: Frozen reconstructed joint mediation reaches cosine >=0.90, relative L2 <=0.40, signs >=0.90, and cosine >=0.85 within each unseen template.
predictions.pred_f_exact_fixed_program_and_price: All base replay and decomposition errors <=5e-5; no fit, gain/vector/reader change, gradients, or updates; at most 17 causal physical forwards and 4192 causal example evaluations after one 96-example capability forward.

terminal_rule: Invalid if a/f fails; prospective_program_screen if b-e all pass; null if instrument passes and e fails; otherwise inconclusive.
